title: Hello, Biology! Introduce Yourself and Your Field
objective: Students start using English to introduce themselves, biology interests, and simple study goals.
context: You meet a new student at a campus pond. You like frogs.

items.prompt: Greet your partner. Say your name and what you study.
items.answer: Accept a polite greeting, a name and a field of study.
items.hint: Try: Hello, my name is ___. I study ___.

items.prompt: Say what interests you and give one reason.
items.answer: Example: I like frogs because they live on land and in water.
items.hint: Use: I am interested in ___ because ___.

items.prompt: Ask one question about your partner’s interest. Wait for an answer.
items.answer: Accept a clear, relevant question and time for a reply.
